feeds.title: Sabaton
feeds.description: In over two decades since their launch, Swedish metallers Sabaton have carved out a reputation as one of the hardest working bands in the business - gaining a legion of loyal fans across the globe, delivering ten highly-rated studio albums (including two certified platinum-sellers), and scoring multiple industry awards wins and nominations not to mention launching their own annual festival and cruise.

feeds.title: Flying Fiddlesticks Music Blog » Sweden
feeds.description: Flying Fiddlesticks Music Blog is dedicated to music for its own sake. We write recaps and reviews of music festivals and shows in order to promote live music as a life-improving experience. We cover new music releases and conduct interviews with artists to help get the word out. Music makes everything better. Get all the latest news from Flying Fiddlesticks Music. Find out all the latest information about tours and shows, music, videos & more.

feeds.title: The Swedish Progg Blog
feeds.description: The Swedish Progg Blog is a website for reviews of Swedish progg albums from the golden era of 1967-1982. Learn about Swedish vocals, English vocals, other languages, and instrumental International relevance.

feeds.title: Alfitude » Swedish Music
feeds.description: Globally recognized as one the most respected new music tastemaker sites since 2010, Alfitude is followed by some of the largest and most influential record & publishing labels around the world. Get to know about Swedish music in depth through the articles provided in Swedish music on the website.

feeds.title: World Music Central » Swedish Music
feeds.description: World Music Central is an online magazine dedicated to World Music. We feature the latest international news, CD and concert reviews, articles, and many resources (in the form of a wiki) for music fans, industry professionals, and researchers. Our definition of World Music includes traditional and contemporary folk and roots music from the entire globe, as well as cross-cultural fusions and hybrids. Read the articles in Swedish Music and find your connection to traditional and contemporary World Music, including folk, roots, global music, ethno, and cross-cultural fusions

feeds.title: Scandinavian Soul » Sweden
feeds.description: Scandinavian Soul is here to support and promote the soul sound, to stage events and gigs, to raise awareness, to interview and review the artists, and to act as a voice for the music that we love. In the Sweden section, the experts provide informative articles from the industry about stage events and gigs, to raise awareness, interview and review the artists and many more.
